findings.description: Pierre Henri Désobry's wife was Clemence Sauselle. The tree currently records no spouse for him, though it records two children (Philibert b. 1800, Jean Baptiste Aimé b. 1813).
supporting_sources: France, Nord, Parish and Civil Registration, 1524-1893 — civil marriage registration, 28 Apr 1798, Pecquencourt, Pierre Henry Desobry and Clémence Lancelle (ark:/61903/1:1:8NW5-26T2) — 'Lancelle' is the same woman as 'Sauselle'/'Sanselle', per the five-record spelling-variant cluster in the README

findings.description: Pierre Henri Désobry and Clemence Sauselle had a son, Julien Désobri, born 5 September 1808 in Pecquencourt — between the tree's two known children (Philibert b. 1800, Jean Baptiste Aimé b. 1813). Direct evidence is the birth registration; his death in infancy is inferred at Probable tier from the absence of any later record (birth, marriage, or otherwise) for him in the same indexed collection that captures the family's other vital events, not from a located death registration — an exhaustive search (four query variants, 1808-1850) found none.

target_person.name: Julien Désobri
target_person.death: in infancy, date/record not located; inferred from absence of later records

supporting_sources: France, Nord, Parish and Civil Registration, 1524-1893 — birth registration (Act 53), 5 Sep 1808, Pecquencourt, of Julien Joseph Desbry, naming father Pierre Henri Desbry (ark:/61903/1:1:8NW1-RP6Z) — the confirming record for his existence and parentage
